source_detail: 5과 Understanding Others / 학습지 번호 3 / Grammar (1) to부정사(목적격 보어)
body_text: One day, something unusual happened to me. While I was relaxing in my car, I heard a knock. I turned around and couldn't see anything. Then, I heard it again. I opened the window and saw a goose pecking at the car door. It wouldn't stop, so I got out of the car. Then the bird began to walk away. I wondered why and wanted to find the reason. As I followed the goose, it kept turning around to see if I was still behind. When it finally stopped, I saw a baby goose trapped in some strings. The goose needed my help to free its baby. After a few minutes, I freed the little bird, and it went to its mom. I was really moved.

emphasis_spans.surface: needed my help to free its baby

transcription.note: 0단계 1차 검증. 이중 전사 미적용 — 육안 대조로 확정.
